label: EXPLORATORY, post hoc (010, 2026-10-06); CPU only; saved LL matrices; dev brew (48 tables, 183 pairs) unless stated; no multiplicity correction; wording: decodable through the reader's likelihood

conventions.D: 006's per-pair D_t = [LL_m(t_m) - LL_m(t_p)] - [LL_p(t_m) - LL_p(t_p)]; table = mean over its scorable pairs; start/answer collision-free (006 census: 63 collisions each, 120 scorable pairs, 44 tables)
conventions.bootstrap: table-cluster, B=10,000, default_rng(20261004).integers (007 boot_idx); pair-level statistics resample tables and keep all their pairs; percentile 95% CI
conventions.derangement_null: 1,000 derangements of tables (default_rng(1); first 200 = 006's); the second instrument's per-table values are permuted; one-sided p = (1 + #null >= obs) / 1001
conventions.partial: partial correlation of two instruments' per-pair (or per-table) D controlling for the model's own D at the same cell and role (006b); model_cov_share = cov(a,m) cov(b,m) / (var(m) cov(a,b)) = share of the a-b covariance carried by the linear model term
conventions.lens_scores: 002's per-render colour scores; log(clip(p, 1e-30)) for softmax lenses, raw cosine for J_NP-cos (002's transform); probabilities are stored rounded to 1e-7, so J_CB log-scores are coarse for small p; J_NP standard excluded (thousands of exact zeros)
conventions.007_scorers: 007 Oracle pieces use the exact 2-row scorer (bf16 layout differs from 006's; whole reproduces 006's D_z to 0.001); 007 NLA pieces use 006's 24-row scorer (A2/A3)

leverage.note: 001 whole-cell patch share S (p->m) at ':' on the 82 gated dev pairs; layer matched to the reader (model output and the NLA: L42). Low S = no single-cell leverage at that cell, not 'not used'.
